top_stories.title: IDScan sued over alleged data breach affecting 153 million drivers
top_stories.summary: IDScan, an identity verification company, is facing multiple lawsuits after hackers allegedly breached its systems and offered to sell data from more than 153 million driver's licenses. The breach targets a company whose core business is identity document scanning and verification, directly impacting a critical component of identity proofing workflows.

top_stories.title: 39 New Methods That Compromise Passkey Authentication
top_stories.summary: Researchers have documented 39 attack methods that can compromise passkey-based authentication systems without breaking FIDO2 cryptography. The vulnerabilities target authentication prompts, synced credentials, enrollment processes, recovery mechanisms, and other trust boundaries in passkey implementations.

top_stories.title: Impersonating IT support: how threat actors turn a remote session into enterprise-wide access
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence documented a human-operated attack campaign that abuses Microsoft Teams external access features to impersonate IT support personnel and gain remote session control. Attackers use social engineering via Teams to deploy a Node.js-based implant, enabling lateral movement toward enterprise-wide access.

top_stories.title: New identity governance and access features in Microsoft Entra
top_stories.summary: Microsoft released multiple generally available and preview updates to Microsoft Entra in September 2026, covering identity governance and access management features. The updates include tenant governance, user-centric access reviews, lifecycle workflow management, passwordless Teams device identities, and hybrid identity enhancements.

top_stories.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Bug Following Disclosure
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Exploitation attempts followed the public disclosure of the flaw in the repository manager platform.

news.title: Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
news.summary: JetBrains suffered a security breach in its Cadence environment after threat actors exploited an unpatched critical vulnerability in TeamCity, resulting in the extraction of AWS credentials. JetBrains is urging all Cadence users to immediately revoke and rotate any credentials and secrets used in their Cadence executions.

news.title: Critical Citrix NetScaler auth bypass now leveraged in attacks
news.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler (CVE-2026-19490) is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows attackers to bypass authentication controls on NetScaler appliances, which are widely used for application delivery and access management.

news.title: Microsoft Teams is about to make QR code phishing much harder
news.summary: Microsoft is developing a feature for Microsoft Teams that will automatically hide QR codes sent by external users, requiring recipients to manually reveal the image before viewing or scanning it. The feature is scheduled to roll out in October 2026 across Android, desktop, iOS, and Mac platforms.

news.title: A five-part inventory for your AI agent credentials
news.summary: Roy Katmor, co-founder and CEO of Orchid, outlines a five-part inventory framework for managing AI agent credentials that fall outside standard identity review processes. The video focuses on how AI agents are granted accounts and credentials to access enterprise tools like HR systems, identity providers, ticketing, and payroll without being subject to normal identity governance workflows.

news.title: New infosec products of the week: September 4, 2026
news.summary: A weekly product roundup covers new releases from BugBase, F5 Networks, Ping Identity, and Superna. The Ping Identity inclusion makes it marginally relevant to IAM, though the article focuses broadly on infosec products rather than detailing Ping Identity's specific release.

news.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration
news.summary: Pathlock has been named a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration. The recognition positions Pathlock within the IGA market landscape, which Gartner describes as highlighting emerging risks and opportunities in the evolving sector.

news.title: Thomson Reuters Court Software Breach May Have Exposed SSNs and Sealed Data
news.summary: Thomson Reuters disclosed that an unauthorized party accessed files from C-Track, its West Publishing court case management platform, in March 2026, affecting courts in 11 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Ontario, Canada. The breach potentially exposed sensitive personal data including Social Security Numbers and sealed court records, with the intrusion discovered on June 30, 2026.

news.title: Shai-Hulud's Reach Just Grew to 469 Credential Locations. Here's What That Means
news.summary: GitGuardian researchers discovered that the Shai-Hulud infostealer worm has evolved to scan for credentials across 469 locations, up from 189 in earlier variants. The expanded targeting covers developer environments, CI/CD tooling, cloud configurations, and AI tool configs.

news.title: Researcher Releases FalconFlank PoC Showing Privilege Escalation in CrowdStrike Falcon
news.summary: A security researcher released a proof-of-concept exploit called FalconFlank demonstrating a zero-day privilege escalation vulnerability in CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor. The flaw abuses the office malicious macros remediation feature in the Falcon Sensor to achieve privilege escalation.

news.title: Microsoft Security enhancements: Defender MDR Plan 2, Entra Tenant Governance, Intune Autopilot, Purview Auto-Labeling, and AI Agent Containment
news.summary: Microsoft has released a set of security enhancements including Entra Tenant Governance for multi-tenant identity governance management. The update also includes Defender MDR Plan 2 for third-party log detection, Intune Autopilot improvements, Purview auto-labeling throughput increases, and new AI agent containment guidance.

news.title: An infostealer log can bypass MFA—respond within the first hour
news.summary: Research highlights that infostealer logs can contain active browser session tokens and identity-provider cookies that allow attackers to bypass MFA entirely. Security teams are advised to treat corporate credentials found in infostealer logs as live identity compromises requiring response within the first hour to invalidate active sessions.

news.title: Your Employee’s Password Appeared in an Infostealer Log. Now What?
news.summary: Flare published guidance on responding to employee credential exposure via infostealer malware logs, highlighting that stolen data can include authenticated session tokens capable of bypassing MFA. The article covers how defenders can prioritize compromised identities and assess whether stolen access remains active.

news.title: The $100M Signal: Why AI Agent Security is Becoming Its Own Category
news.summary: The article discusses the emergence of AI agent security as a distinct security category, driven by the rise of autonomous AI systems that can execute tasks and access data on behalf of users. The piece addresses how traditional identity and access management approaches are being challenged by AI agents that require new authorization and authentication frameworks.

news.title: Keeper Security Names Jessica Krowel and Bill Grabner to Lead North America Private and Public Sector Sales
news.summary: Keeper Security appointed Jessica Krowel and Bill Grabner to lead North America private and public sector sales, respectively. The hires follow the company's recognition as the second fastest-growing security software company globally.

news.title: Back to the Future: Why Agentic AI Needs a Strong Identity Foundation
news.summary: The article examines the identity infrastructure requirements for agentic AI deployments in enterprise environments. It focuses on how AI agents require robust identity foundations—including authentication, authorization, and access management—to operate securely across use cases.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores, personnel records, and reactor databases. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of authentication credentials alongside sensitive operational data.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, reportedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official investigation into the breach.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealer malware to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Anthropic Claude user accounts. The attack involved session hijacking techniques to bypass authentication on an unknown number of compromised accounts.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The case involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts and theft of AT&T call and text records belonging to more than 100 million customers.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA issued a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection, with security experts drawing broader lessons for security teams around access key hygiene and exposure monitoring.
